Package neqsim.process.equipment.reactor

Class AqueousCO2HydrationTrajectory

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.reactor.AqueousCO2HydrationTrajectory
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class AqueousCO2HydrationTrajectory extends Object implements Serializable
Exact piecewise-isothermal propagation of the qualified aqueous CO2/H2CO3 pair.

Each segment delegates to AqueousCO2HydrationKinetics.advance(double, double, double, double) and therefore uses the Soli-Byrne first-order correlations only inside their published 288.15-305.65 K and 0.65 molal NaCl boundary. The result does not add pressure correction, phase transfer, electrolyte speciation, or a pipeline source term.

1.0

    • advance

      public static AqueousCO2HydrationTrajectory.TrajectoryResult advance(double co2Concentration, double carbonicAcidConcentration, double[] segmentDurationsSeconds, double[] temperaturesK)
      Advance a closed aqueous CO2/H2CO3 pair through piecewise-isothermal segments.

      The cumulative relaxation exposure is sum((kH(T_i) + kD(T_i)) * duration_i). It is useful as a dimensionless diagnostic, but a changing temperature also changes the pair equilibrium target. Consequently the exposure must not be interpreted as one global remaining-deviation fraction. Final concentrations are obtained from the ordered sequence of exact analytical updates.

      Parameters:
      co2Concentration - initial aqueous CO2 concentration [mol/m3]
      carbonicAcidConcentration - initial H2CO3 concentration [mol/m3]
      segmentDurationsSeconds - ordered segment durations [s]
      temperaturesK - ordered aqueous temperatures corresponding to the durations [K]
      Returns:
      immutable trajectory result
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when concentrations or arrays are invalid, arrays are empty or have different lengths, any duration is negative or non-finite, any temperature is outside the published range, or an accumulated quantity is non-finite
